desc: Prove the canonical matching claim: if \(K\) pairs are possible in a sorted interval, pairing its first \(K\) mochi with its last \(K\) mochi in order is also possible.
Derive the \(p_j\), \(B_j\), and range-maximum feasibility criterion, including correct indexing and boundary cases.
Design sparse-table preprocessing and \(O(\log N)\)-time binary search per query.
Implement the complete Python solution with fast input/output and verify it against both provided samples.
